data.transcript:
Speaker 1
Sorry to keep you waiting. I get to do that cuz I'm a doctor. So tell me what's going on. I seriously can't stop eating sugar. Well that sounds like a blood sugar issue to me.
Speaker 1

Speaker 1

Speaker 1
Or gut signaling again gut. So fiber and amino acids will support healthy digestion and also could help you feel fuller, satiate. You want me to take five different supplements? Not gonna get expensive. You could, but I don't know who would want to because you can get all the same nutrients in Rosabellas.
Speaker 1
Moringa has all those nutrients in one single plant. There are no fillers non GMO third party tested in the US so you know exactly what you're putting into your body. They're just pure moringa leaf. So instead of buying six different capsules, you get it all in one. And that's exactly why they've already sold over five units on TikTok alone.
Speaker 1
If they're still in stock, I would definitely grab a couple bottles of them because they sell out constantly.
data.hook: “Sorry to keep you waiting. I get to do that cuz I’m a doctor.”
data.desire: Understand cravings, tiredness, body changes and skin concerns without an expensive multi-supplement routine.
data.angle: Conversational symptom-to-nutrient mapping, resolved by one-plant consolidation.
data.belief_shift: Advertised shift: several frustrating concerns seem to require several supplements; Moringa is presented as one nutritional answer.
data.script_structure: Doctor-role joke → sugar complaint/nutrient response → caffeine/fatigue response → lower-belly/cortisol response → skin/gut response → hunger/gut response → five-supplement cost objection → Rosabella Moringa reveal → purity/testing → six-capsule consolidation → ambiguous sales assertion → stock CTA.
data.mechanism_reveal: Each complaint is assigned a nutrient or body-system explanation before Moringa is presented as containing the inputs. These are script claims, not a verified diagnosis or demonstrated product benefit.
data.proof: Doctor-role framing, named nutrients, third-party US-testing assertion, ambiguous TikTok sales number. No credential verification or actual test report in saved material.
data.cta: Grab a couple of bottles if still in stock.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation: repeated exchanges build a shopping-list problem, then the cost objection lets the product consolidate it. Different from a single hidden-cause story.
data.transferable_move: Dramatize several genuine use cases, then show a substantiated multi-function product responding to the resulting cost/complexity objection. Do not copy diagnostic shortcuts or unverified sales proof.
data.opening_visual: Exact first frame not verified. Sampled frames show a woman in a white coat, green headphones, subtitles and a supplement container near the consolidation close.
data.transition_to_product: “You want me to take five different supplements?” introduces the cost objection; “you can get all the same nutrients in Rosabellas” reveals the product.
data.proof_placement: Authority framing opens; ingredient assertions recur throughout; purity/testing and sales assertions follow product reveal.
